message: As a grandparent, I’ve learned that when it comes to preparedness, it’s often a tug-of-war between wanting to keep my family safe and the kids' eye-rolling at my ‘over-preparation.’ 😄 But having a solid plan can really ease those wiggly feelings. I found this great resource that lays out helpful supplies for a survival kit – a way to turn that eye-roll into a nod of approval. After all, being ready means more time for fun together! What’s your go-to tip for getting the kids involved in staying prepared?
